assignmentHtml.task: Research El Payaso Plim Plim YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: who runs this? Colombian entertainer Andrés Calamaro or related entity? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages (Spanish). (6) Primary content category (children's entertainment/puppet show). (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: El Payaso Plim Plim is #42 with ~58-59B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for El Payaso Plim Plim with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Dossier for El Payaso Plim Plim YouTube channel:

(1) STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL: Channel ID UCYQo8CdhXD22qfwUBUw591Q. Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYQo8CdhXD22qfwUBUw591Q. Handle: @elcanaldePlimPlim.

(2) OPERATOR: Created by Guillermo Pino (producer/marketing expert, founder of Smilehood, President of Spiritum Entertainment) and Claudio Pousada (TV creative director). Brand owned by Kids Magic LLC. NOT Andrés Calamaro — Calamaro is an unrelated Argentine rock musician with no connection to this children's brand.

(3) CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD: Channel created October 18, 2013. Earliest still-public uploads dated December 6, 2013: 'La Muñeca Perdida | (Temporada 2)' and 'Las Palabras Mágicas | (Temporada 2)'.

(4) OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY: Argentina.

(5) LANGUAGES: Primary language is Spanish. Separate international channels exist in English ('Plim Plim - The Kindness Hero', created Oct 10, 2014, US-based), Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, and Russian.

(6) PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY: Preschool children's educational entertainment (animated series + nursery rhymes for ages 0–5). YouTube classifies it under Music/Entertainment due to its song-driven format.

(7) CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL: Primarily in-house production by Spiritum/Smilehood using Moho and Adobe Creative Suite (transitioning to Toon Boom), supported by an internal team of animators, directors, writers, and musicians. Collaborations with animation studios and independent artists across Latin America. Multi-platform strategy: YouTube, TV channels (Disney Junior LATAM, Universal Kids, Discovery Familia; own 24-hour Latin American channel since Sep 2023), streaming platforms, mobile apps, theater tours, merchandise licensing (Bandai, Arbrex, Penguin Random House).

(8) REPRESENTATIVE WORKS: 'Abejita Chiquitita' (1.8B+ YouTube views; 1.9B plays on YouTube Music); 'Abejita Chiquitita Y Más Canciones Infantiles Para Conocer Animales' (522M views, premiered Oct 24, 2023); 'La Vaca Lola Y Su Familia Canciones Infantiles' (~396M views); 'Las Canciones de Plim Plim Vol. 1–12' album compilation series; 'A Ram Sam Sam 🕺 ¡De Animales!' (7.4M views); full episode compilations from Seasons 1 and 2.
